# `company.delivery_message_documents`

Files attached to a message, frozen when it was drafted: source, revision, name, size, hash.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this attached file. |
| `message_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with message_id + position | — | delivery_messages.id | Message the file is attached to. |
| `position` | INTEGER | no | — | unique with message_id + position | — | — | One-based order of the attachment. |
| `role` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | document (the rendered PDF) or attached-file (a file linked to the document). |
| `source_kind` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | ix_delivery_documents_source | — | Kind of the source document. |
| `source_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_delivery_documents_source | — | Source document id; for a statement, the customer. |
| `source_revision` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | Source revision when drafted; null for a statement or notice. |
| `statement_from` | VARCHAR(10) | yes | — | — | — | — | A statement source: first day of the period. |
| `statement_to` | VARCHAR(10) | yes | — | — | — | — | A statement source: last day of the period. |
| `file_name` | VARCHAR(255) | no | — | — | — | — | File name as attached. |
| `media_type` | VARCHAR(127) | no | — | — | — | — | Media type as attached. |
| `size_bytes` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Size of the frozen bytes. |
| `sha256` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | — | — | — | SHA-256 of the frozen bytes (delivery_files; pruned once no standing message carries them, the hash kept here). |
| `attachment_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | Attachment-store file, for an attached file. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this attached file was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this attached file. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this attached file. |
